title: The old landing is the brief view at /brief and /en/brief: English paths, canonical to its landing, no 3D map
body: Decided by the author 2026-10-29 when v2 took / and /en/. The previous landing (src/components/HomeDocument.astro) lives on as the 'vista breve' / 'brief view' at /brief and /en/brief (src/pages/brief.astro, src/pages/en/brief.astro; LOCALE_PATHS.*.brief in src/lib/anchors.ts). Paths are English in BOTH locales (author's rule, also in CLAUDE.md); anchors still follow the page language. It repeats the landing's facts, so Base.astro gets canonicalPath = that locale's home, astro.config.mjs's sitemap filter drops /brief/, and it is NOT in HREFLANG and has no Open Graph: one page competes in search. Do not make it self-canonical or add it to the sitemap without the author. The 3D knowledge map (three, src/scripts/lab, GraphSvg, knowledge-graph/graph-layout) was removed with it, not kept: do not restore it. LocaleSwitch (only used here) links to the other locale's brief view, and the hero links back to the guided landing; the landing's hero links to the brief view.
not_derivable: The naming, the English-path rule and the canonical/sitemap choice were the author's calls between listed alternatives; the code only shows the result.
